Uses of Package
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.password

Packages that use com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.password
Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.account
Self-service account REST API: registration, e-mail verification, password change and password reset.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.password
Web adapter of the password-based sign-in: the Spring Security user details service over the use case, the password encoder and the authentication provider, which checks the account status only after the password.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.account
Use cases of the account lifecycle: registration, e-mail verification, password change and reset.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.clients
Use cases that manage registered clients.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.mfa
Use cases of the multi-factor framework: security events, second-factor lockout and trusted devices.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.ott
Use cases of the one-time-code (e-mail and SMS) authentication factor: requesting, verifying and cleaning up codes, and the policy beans they share.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.password
Use cases of the password-based sign-in.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.social
Use cases of social login (identity brokering): resolving a sign-in with an external provider to an account (finding it, linking by verified e-mail address, or provisioning it), linking, unlinking and listing the identities of an account.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.totp
Use cases of the TOTP authenticator-app second factor and its recovery codes.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.x509
Use cases of X.509 client certificate sign-in: resolving a certificate fingerprint to an account, binding a certificate to an account and unbinding it.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.password
Password-based user accounts and the port that provides them.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.social
Social login (identity brokering): the identities of external providers linked to an account, the providers supported, how far a provider's multi-factor claim is trusted, and the port that stores the links.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.password
PostgreSQL implementation of the user account port, over the users, user_authorities and user_passwords tables.
